description: This file provides an in-memory indexing utility for Excel sheet metadata within a specific session, including columns, data types, sample data, and optional column embeddings using Gemini AI. It exposes functions for updating indices, retrieving columns by name, and fetching embeddings, primarily used for semantic mapping between DataFrame columns and LLM queries.
